propositions: MCP gate resolvers (mcp_readonly and mcp_gate) collapse config-read faults into default boolean values instead of raising ConfigError per operator ruling 39f8-ae7c
The fail keyword parameter in config.mcp_gate() exists only to pick malformed-config fallbacks and must be removed along with parameter forwarding in mcp_server._mcp_gate
MCP error envelope must classify ConfigError as the new code config_unreadable and surface it structurally instead of as an opaque crash
gate_unreadable event-schema value is historical only; unreadable config must error per 39f8-ae7c, not fail open
config.mcp_readonly() and config.mcp_gate(attr) must raise ConfigError chained from parse fault with message naming the gate and the operator ruling
Consumer code paths (_readonly_gate, _allow_llm, _allow_jira_sync, _readonly) must propagate the ConfigError without swallowing it
